digest.component_or_area: application-wide operation-scoped configuration and provider authentication composition
propositions: Rebar must resolve one immutable, serializable, non-secret OperationSnapshot at each operation boundary following a strict precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default.
Repository root resolution must follow: explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory, with relative paths interpreted against the winning root.
In-progress operations must not reread ambient environment, files, working directory, or global config; CLI composes once per invocation while MCP and Python compose once per operation.

Provider-native authentication must inject only through RP-01's existing PydanticAIRunner -> per-run ProviderSession -> one-Agent path, preserving budget, retry history, cache/accounting, typed exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, and failure translation.

Static secrets must be represented as provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers revealed only in the sending adapter; no universal secret broker, central credential union, automatic keyring fallback, or application-owned cloud-secret retrieval.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network creation, and copy the key into a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, with static bindings rotating only on restart/redeploy.
